item.title: Does your small business need an app, or just a better website?

item.title: How we test AI before it talks to your customers
item.description: AI can be wrong. This is how we test it, set limits and keep a person in the loop before an AI feature goes live for your customers.

item.title: Chatbot or AI agent? Picking the right level of automation
item.description: A chatbot answers. An agent acts. Here is how to choose the simplest option that does the job, and when plain automation is enough.
